run_moe_fused_mul_sum: run moe_fused_mul_sum to compute weighted summation of expert outputs for MoE models
test_moe_fused_mul_sum: test moe_fused_mul_sum with inputs shape (num_tokens, top_k, hidden_size) and topk_weights shape (num_tokens, top_k)
summarize_moe_fused_mul_sum_kernel: summarize the moe_fused_mul_sum_kernel Triton JIT kernel that performs fused multiply-and-accumulate for MoE weighted summation
review_moe_fused_mul_sum: review moe_fused_mul_sum with optional expert_map for expert parallelism and topk_ids for masking invalid token-expert pairs
build_moe_fused_mul_sum_heuristic: build heuristic config for moe_fused_mul_sum to select optimal BLOCK_M, BLOCK_K, num_warps, and num_stages based on device capability
